Thuy Ha Pham

Internal Accountant

An Internal Accountant with over 3 years of experience, proficient in accounting software and internal accounting operations. In 2024, I was awarded "Employee of the Year" for accurately recording financial transactions and supporting effective cash flow control. My goal in the next two years is to become a General Accountant and contribute to improving financial management at your company.

Học vấn

TopCV University

Major: Accounting

Thông tin cá nhân

hotro@topcv.vn

be.net/tencuaban

Quận Đống Đa, Hà Nội

Kinh nghiệm làm việc

TopCV A Company

Internal Accountant

(

01/2022

-

Now

)

  • Monitor, record, and control business revenues and expenses, ensuring financial transparency and accuracy.
  • Simplified the document verification process (invoices, receipts, contracts, etc.), reducing processing time by 20%.
  • Proficient in MISA accounting software, contributing to a 10% increase in individual productivity.
  • Prepared internal revenue/expense reports and cash flow statements to support financial analysis.
  • Compiled periodic (weekly/monthly/quarterly) and ad-hoc financial reports as required.
  • Organized and archived accounting documents systematically for easy retrieval.
  • Prepared and verified invoices in compliance with company regulations.
  • Processed payroll for over 200 employees monthly with a 98% accuracy rate over 3 years.
  • Assisted in preparing documentation for tax declaration and audits.

TopCV B Company

Accounting Intern

(

12/2020

-

12/2021

)

  • Supported data entry for accounting documents (invoices, receipts, bank transactions, etc.) into accounting software.
  • Assisted accountants in checking and reconciling receivables and payables with clients and suppliers.
  • Sorted and archived accounting files in accordance with internal policies.
  • Helped prepare simple internal reports as assigned.
  • Supported admin tasks such as photocopying, filing, and document organization.
  • Assisted in issuing e-invoices, storing XML files, and providing invoice copies upon request.

Hoạt động

  • Organized internal training sessions to enhance members' accounting expertise.

Solid knowledge of internal accounting operations

Proficient in accounting software (e.g. MISA)

Familiar with legal regulations on accounting

Strong data analysis skills

Financial reporting and documentation skills
